items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I don't know what he is, but he says, I will play saxophone in Jimmy Gordon's combo... Probably a different Jimmy Gordon.

ctx.x: And this blues singer, Jimmy Gordon. I don't know what he is, man.

Yeah. That's a combo. Jimmy Gordon's in saxophone. No, that's like Jimmy Gordon. I don't know what he is, but he says, I will play saxophone in Jimmy Gordon's combo, that's what it says right here. Yeah. But that's where he lives, 6136 Englewood. Probably a different Jimmy Gordon.
